'''Theodore''' (Japanese: '''タクゾウ''' ''Takuzo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP124|To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!]]''. He made it to the finals of the [[Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament]] with his {{p|Gliscor}} and lost against [[O]] and his {{p|Shiftry}}. He did not have a speaking role in the episode and never appeared in person, but his face appeared on the screen showing the finalists.
